shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (stack + log-prefix + Harmony patch-owner attribution, a shipped known-issue library plus a benign "no-concern" library, mod-shipped + opt-in community bug DBs, About.xml incompat + proactive dependency/load-order scan, and a glossary), a global knowledge-base browser that surfaces every source in one window, an in-game bug/fix report composer, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT).

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, no `GameFont.Tiny`, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. `Palette.SearchField` = suite-styled single-line text/search field; used by the modern log search, the dev-actions search, and the knowledge-base search.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Inspector: impact banner (`ImpactAssessor`) → likely source (ranked culprits) → "What this means" (diagnoses, sorted by Score) → module `DrawSection` hooks (glossary) → report card → stack trace.
- **Auto-open suppression toggle (settings, off by default): `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`.** `Patch_CheckOpenLogWindow` suppresses auto-open while `ProgramState.Entry`; still auto-opens in-game; manual open always works.
- **Toolbar B buttons (right→left):** Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, **Knowledge base** (`MDT_KbButton`, opens `Window_KnowledgeBase`), then the search field fills the rest.

### Benign "no concern" classification
Normal no-fault vanilla log lines (version banner, "Initializing new game with mods:", etc.) are classified via `KnownIssueDef.benign` (curated in `Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml`). `KnownIssueIndex.HasBenignMatch(ctx)` runs before the module loop (only when `msg.type != Error`), sets `ctx.Benign`; while set, `ErrorContext.Merge` no-ops all attribution (kills packageId-dump noise). Inspector shows a green "No concern" badge, forces impact to Info, hides the report card.

### Analysis modules ("What this means") + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module: `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`; diagnoses sorted by `Score`. Modules: `Module_StackTrace`, `Module_LogPrefix`, `Module_MessageMentions`, `Module_HarmonyPatches`, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_Community`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, `Module_DependencyCheck`, `Module_Glossary`.
- **Index prewarm** (`Bootstrap` → `InstalledModIndex.Prewarm()` off-thread). Harmony index built lazily on first analysis.
- **Harmony patch-owner attribution** (`HarmonyIndex` + `Module_HarmonyPatches`): reverse-maps `"Type.FullName:Method" → owner-id[]`. Diagnosis when ≥2 foreign patchers or a Harmony-routed trace. Self excluded.
- **Proactive dependency & load-order scan** (`ModDependencyIndex` + `Module_DependencyCheck`, order 60): mirrors vanilla `GetModWarnings`/`FindConflicts`.
- **Plain-language glossary** (`Glossary` + `Module_Glossary`, `DrawSection`, order 900).

### Tool 4: global knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
A source-agnostic reference browser for **everything the mod knows**, independent of any selected error. Opened from the log's **Knowledge base** button. Suite chrome (`doWindowBackground=false`, `Margin=>0`), left rail of 8 categories + right searchable content pane; every entry is a card citing its provenance (built-in / community DB / shipped-by-a-mod / your mod list / live Harmony registry). Deferred search focus one frame; per-section draws sandboxed in try/catch; content height measured on Layout for the scroll viewRect.
- **Sources** — dashboard: one clickable row per source with live status + count (`MDT_KbEntries`), a state dot (green loaded / warn findings / gray off), and an inline community-data status + "Enable and update" control (`CommStatus`, `EnableAndUpdate`). Rows `Select(...)` their tab.
- **Known issues** — every non-benign `KnownIssueDef`, card = title/description/fix/url + a "Triggers on:" signal summary (`SignalText` over exceptionTypes/keywords/regex count/namespaces/packageIds), tagged built-in or `shipped by {mod}` (`TagFor` via `def.modContentPack`). Ignorable entries get a gray strip.
- **Benign log lines** — benign `KnownIssueDef`s, green strip, calm explanation.
- **Community bugs** — two sections: our community DB (`CommunityData.AllBugs`) and `ModShippedIssues.All`, each `RemoteIssue` carried as a card with reportedBy tag. Shows an enable hint when community data is off.
- **Compatibility** — **scoped to installed/active mods**: About.xml incompat pairs (`AboutIncompatIndex.ActivePairs`), community RimSort rules where both sides are active (`CommunityData.RuleFor`, deduped against About via `PairKey`), and Use This Instead replacements for mods you have (`CommunityData.ReplacementFor`, workshop link). Memoized (`Compat()`/`BuildCompat`) keyed on a community-data stamp.
- **Dependencies** — `ModDependencyIndex.All`: per-mod missing deps (with installed-but-inactive vs not-installed state) + load-order violation lines.
- **Harmony patches** — built lazily from `HarmonyIndex.Snapshot()` (`BuildHarmony`→`HPatch`). Summary (total patched methods + conflict count), then **lists every patched method** with its resolved patcher name(s) via `InstalledModIndex.MatchOwnerId` (self resolves to "Modern Dev Tools"). Each `HPatch` carries `ForeignCount` = distinct patchers other than self; methods with `ForeignCount >= 2` are conflict candidates — sorted to the top and given an amber strip; single-patcher methods get a neutral gray strip. Full `Type:Method` shown as the dim line. Capped at 300 after search. (Earlier version listed conflicts only, which read as "empty" when nothing was contested — now the full list populates.)
- **Glossary** — all `Glossary.AllTerms()` term/definition pairs.
- **New read-only accessors added for the browser:** `CommunityData.AllBugs`/`BugsCount`/`RulesCount`/`ReplacementsCount`; `HarmonyIndex.BuiltMethodCount` (no-build) / `PatchedMethodCount` (builds) / `Snapshot()`; `Glossary.AllTerms()`.

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached, offline fallback. Sources: RimSort Community Rules, Use This Instead, and our own **known-issues.json** at `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` (PUBLIC, live, 14 signatures). Offline snapshot ships gzipped at `Data/community-bugs.json.gz`.

### In-game reporting (`ReportBuilder`, `Dialog_Report`)
Server-less composer; destination hierarchy: culprit mod's GitHub → its Workshop page → community Issue Form repo. Signature = FNV-1a → `[#xxxxxxxx]`. `ReportBuilder.FullReport` flattens an error's analysis to text (also the "Copy report" payload).

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Reuses vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph; adds category "Modern Dev Tools" with test-log/exception actions (all `Anywhere`-gated) incl. glossary + benign demos. Spawn pickers = searchable icon grid. Esc steps up one level; hides the dev palette while open; whole-tab BFS search (time-boxed, focus deferred one frame).

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`. Resolves pinned nodes from `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette`. Nested breadcrumb paths; auto-fit size.

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` → indicator → `Dialog_ModChanges`. `Dialog_UpdateNotes` once per Version.

### Experimental hardening (two toggles, off by default)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`.

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`) on focus changes, NOT the mod.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`). Knowledge-base keys: `MDT_KbButton`/`MDT_KbButtonTip`/`MDT_KbTitle`, tab names `MDT_KbTab*`, source dashboard `MDT_KbSource*`/`MDT_KbEntries`, provenance tags `MDT_KbTag*`/`MDT_KbSignals`, section headers `MDT_KbSec*`, empty states (incl. `MDT_KbHarmonyEmpty`) + compat/dep/harmony entry strings.

## GitHub Backup
Open source (MIT). Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC). `origin` on Astryls; `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked; `Source/**/{bin,obj}` ignored.
